name: Four Seasons Danieli
positioning: Hotel set across three interconnecting palaces on the Riva degli Schiavoni in Venice, steps from Piazza San Marco
best_for: Travelers who want to stay steps from Piazza San Marco
Families and friends wanting connecting guest rooms and suites

facts.text: The hotel's address is Riva degli Schiavoni, 4196, 30122 Venezia VE, Italy.
The hotel is located just steps from Piazza San Marco.
The Danieli is composed of three interconnecting palaces.
The Palazzo Dandolo was converted to a hotel in 1822.
The hotel lists 120 accommodations, including 52 suites, in 2026.
Restaurant Terrazza Danieli offers indoor and outdoor seating with panoramic views of the city and lagoon.
Bar Dandolo offers coffee or crafted cocktails.
The hotel has a 24-hour fitness centre.
Guest rooms and suites are newly renovated according to the vision of Pierre-Yves Rochon.
Private water taxis are located just a few steps from the Danieli and available 24 hours through the Concierge.

highlights.text: The lobby is a four-storey atrium with soaring pink marble columns.
The lobby has an iconic golden staircase.
The Danieli offers a high number of connecting guest rooms and suites.
The Presidential Suite is perched on the topmost fourth floor of the Danieli's Palazzo Dandolo.
The Grand Lagoon-View Suite has views of the Venetian Lagoon and the Grand Canal.

considerations.text: The Danieli Spa is listed as opening in late 2026.
The swimming pool is listed as opening in late 2026.
Hotel guests are exempt from the Venice access fee but must request a waiver in advance of their visit.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
